EX-99.1 2 mlys2026q38kex991.htm EX-99.1 Document Exhibit 99.1 Mineralys Therapeutics Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Corporate Update – Commercialization plans for lorundrostat are on track ahead of PDUFA target date of December 22, 2026 – – New analyses from the pivotal Launch-HTN trial showed 46% of participants with uncontrolled or resistant hypertension receiving lorundrostat 50 mg achieved the AHA/ACC guideline systolic blood pressure target of <130 mmHg at Week 12 – – Transform-HTN open-label extension trial data selected for late-breaking presentation at American Heart Association Scientific Sessions 2026 – – Conference call today at 4:30 p.m.

As we approach the December 22nd PDUFA target date for lorundrostat, our focus is on completing our launch preparations so that we are ready to reach patients quickly, pending approval,” said Jon Congleton, Chief Executive Officer of Mineralys.

Food and Drug Administration (FDA) continues its review of the NDA for lorundrostat for the treatment of hypertension in combination with other antihypertensive drugs, with a Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) target date of December 22, 2026.
